# 📦 模型下载与存放 / Models

> **3 个文件 · 3 个文件夹 · 全部来自官方仓库**
> 3 files · 3 folders · all from the official repo
>
> 🔗 仓库 Repo：<https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1>
> 🚀 国内镜像 Mirror：<https://hf-mirror.com/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1>
> 🐼 魔搭 ModelScope：<https://modelscope.cn/models/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1>

---

## ⚡ 速查表 / Cheat sheet

| # | 文件 File | 目录 Folder |
|:-:|---|---|
| ① | `qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors` | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| ② | `qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors` | `models/text_encoders/` |
| ③ | `qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors` | `models/vae/` |

---

## ① 主模型 / Diffusion model

**作用**：出图主体，turbo + int8 加速版，8 步出图。
**Role**: the generator — turbo + int8 build, 8 steps.

📥 [HF 直链 / Direct link](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors)
🇨🇳 [国内镜像 / Mirror](https://hf-mirror.com/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors)

📁 放到 → `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`

---

## ② 文本编码器 / Text encoder

**作用**：读提示词，把你写的中文描述翻成模型能懂的条件。
**Role**: reads your prompt and turns it into conditioning.

📥 [HF 直链 / Direct link](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors)
🇨🇳 [国内镜像 / Mirror](https://hf-mirror.com/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors)

📁 放到 → `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`

> ⚠️ **备用方案 / Fallback**
> 上面这条如果 404，就下同目录的 `qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors`，
> 在 CLIPLoader 里换成那个名字，效果一样，只是更吃显存。
> If it 404s, grab `qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors` from the same folder
> and select it in CLIPLoader — same output, higher VRAM.

---

## ③ VAE 解码器 / VAE

**作用**：把潜空间还原成像素图。
**Role**: decodes latents back into pixels.

📥 [HF 直链 / Direct link](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors)
🇨🇳 [国内镜像 / Mirror](https://hf-mirror.com/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors)

📁 放到 → `ComfyUI/models/vae/`

> ⚠️ **必须是 2.1 专用 VAE**，版本不对会出糊图。
> Must be the 2.1 VAE — a mismatched version produces blurry images.

---

## 🗂 放好之后长这样 / Final layout

```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    ├── diffusion_models/
    │   └── qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors
    └── vae/
        └── qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors
```

---

✅ 三个都放对后，**重启 ComfyUI** 或刷新节点列表，Loaders 里就能选到。
✅ Restart or refresh ComfyUI, then pick them in the loaders.

# 🎛 编号切换 / Mode switch (1–5)

> 改左侧 **`easy int`** 节点的数字，切换生成内容。
> Change the **`easy int`** value to switch what this workflow generates.

---

## 📋 对照表 / At a glance

| 编号 No. | 生成内容 Content | 产出 Output |
|:-:|---|---|
| **1** | 表情差分（动漫风）· Emotion sheet (anime) | 1 张 / 8 格 · 1 image / 8 cells |
| **2** | 表情差分（写实风）· Emotion sheet (realistic) | 1 张 / 8 格 · 1 image / 8 cells |
| **3** | 动作差分 · Action sheet | 12 张 / 24 姿势 · 12 images / 24 poses |
| **4** | 多视角 · Multi-angle | 12 个角度 · 12 angles |
| **5** | 自定义 · Custom | 1 张 / 角度·姿势自由 · 1 image, any angle or pose |

---

## 1️⃣ 表情差分 · 动漫风
##  Emotion sheet · Anime

4 列 × 2 行表情网格，八格依次为：
**平静 → 微笑 → 大笑 → 害羞脸红 → 惊讶张嘴 → 生气皱眉 → 闭眼笑 → 侧头看向镜头**

4×2 emotion grid, eight cells in order:
*neutral → smile → laugh → blush → surprised → angry → eyes closed → head turned to camera*

- 🔒 同一人物、同一角度、同一景别、同一背景、同一光照
- 🔒 Same character, same angle, same framing, same background, same lighting

---

## 2️⃣ 表情差分 · 写实风
## Emotion sheet · Realistic

同样是 8 格，但走写实质感，靠**眉毛形态、眼睑开合、嘴角走向、下颌松紧**拉开差别。

Same 8 cells, but rendered realistically — the differences come from
**brow shape, eyelid opening, mouth corner, and jaw tension**.

> 幅度控制在真实情绪区间内，不做瞪眼到眼白全露、咧嘴到耳根这类夸张变形。
> Kept within the natural emotional range — no bug-eyed stares, no ear-to-ear grins.

---

## 3️⃣ 动作差分
## Action sheet

一次出 **12 张**，每张左右两格，合计 **24 个姿势**。
全身、同机位、同光照，服装与脸全程锁死。

**12 images per run**, two poses per image, **24 poses total**.
Full body, same camera, same lighting — outfit and face locked throughout.

> 姿势覆盖：站、坐、跪、趴、举手、伸展、转身、回望……
> Pose coverage: standing, sitting, kneeling, lying, hand raised, stretching, turning, looking back…

---

## 4️⃣ 多视角
## Multi-angle

一次出 **12 个机位**：俯视、侧脸轮廓特写、背面、越肩回望、正面全身等。
同一角色，只换镜头，不换人。

**12 camera angles per run**: high angle, profile close-up, back view, over-the-shoulder look-back, front full body, and more.
Same character — only the camera moves.

---

## 5️⃣ 自定义
## Custom

用你自己写的提示词自由生成，只受参考图约束。
写什么出什么，适合做姿势、构图、镜头的单独实验。

Free-form generation with your own prompt, constrained only by the reference image.
Whatever you write is what you get — good for one-off experiments with pose, composition or camera.

---

## ⚙️ 配套参数 / Companion settings

| 项目 Item | 建议值 Value | 说明 Note |
|---|---|---|
| 生成像素 · Resolution | **400 万 · 4 MP** | 配置低先降这个 · Lower this first on a weak GPU |
| 动作图比例 · Action aspect | **1 : 1** | 方形好裁切 · Square, easier to crop |
| 多角度比例 · Multi-angle aspect | **2 : 3** | 纵向留空间，1:1 会切脚 · Leaves vertical room; 1:1 crops the feet |
| 采样步数 · Steps | **8** | turbo 版专用 · Turbo build only |

# 🔀 三视图提示词切换 / Three-view prompt switch

> 这个开关决定三视图用哪一套提示词生成。
> This toggle picks which prompt set generates the three-view sheet.

| 开关 Toggle | 使用的提示词 Prompt | 什么时候用 When to use |
|:-:|---|---|
| ⬜ **关闭 OFF** | 单图参考 · Single-image | 只有一张立绘 · Only one illustration |
| ☑️ **开启 ON** | 双图参考 · Two-image | 主图 + 补充图 · Main image + supplement |

---

> ⚠️ **重要：双图模式是两个开关，不是一个 / Two toggles, not one**
>
> 选「双图参考」只换了提示词，**不会自动启用第二张图**。
> 必须同时把「开启图2参考」打开，并接入补充图，否则模型看到的仍然只有一张图，跑出来还是单图效果。
>
> Picking "Two-image" only swaps the prompt — it does **not** enable the second image.
> You must also turn on **"Enable image 2 reference"** and connect the supplement image.
> Otherwise the model still sees a single image and you get single-image results.
>
> | 步骤 Step | 操作 Action |
> |:-:|---|
> | ① | 三视图提示词开关 → **双图参考** · Three-view prompt switch → **Two-image** |
> | ② | 「开启图2参考」→ **打开** · "Enable image 2 reference" → **ON** |
> | ③ | `image2` 输入口 → **接入补充图** · Connect the supplement image to `image2` |

---

## ⬜ 关闭 · 单图参考
## ⬜ OFF · Single-image reference

**只拿一张图当角色的唯一造型依据。**
Only one image serves as the sole reference for the character.

- 正面信息最全，脸、发型、服装都从这一张读
- 背面、侧脸轮廓、正面看不到的配饰，由模型按同一套设计语言**推断补全**
- 推断出来的部分不保证和你的设定一致，角色越复杂越容易偏

- All front-facing information comes from this single image: face, hair, outfit
- The back view, profile silhouette and hidden accessories are **inferred** by the model
- Inferred parts are not guaranteed to match your design — the more complex the character, the more it drifts

> 用单图模式时，建议把「开启图2参考」关掉，免得模型读到一个空的第二输入。
> In single-image mode, turn **"Enable image 2 reference"** OFF so the model doesn't read an empty second input.

✅ **适用 / Use when**：只有一张立绘、没有其他参考 · You only have one illustration

---

## ☑️ 开启 · 双图参考
## ☑️ ON · Two-image reference

**第一张定身份，第二张补信息。**
The first image defines identity; the second fills in what's missing.

> 🚨 **开这个之前，先确认另外两件事 / Before enabling this, confirm two more things**
>
> ✅ 「开启图2参考」已打开 · "Enable image 2 reference" is ON
> ✅ `image2` 已经接入补充图 · A supplement image is connected to `image2`
>
> 少任何一项，双图模式都退化成单图。
> Miss either one and two-image mode silently falls back to single-image.

| 输入 Input | 作用 Role |
|:-:|---|
| `<image1>` | 主要依据：脸、五官、发型、正面服装与配饰 · Primary: face, features, hair, front outfit and accessories |
| `<image2>` | 补充依据：背面结构、侧脸、正面看不到的细节 · Secondary: back structure, profile, details hidden from the front |

- 两张图在款式、颜色、比例上**冲突时，一律以 `<image1>` 为准**
- 两张图都没覆盖到的角度，按同一套设计语言合成延续
- 不会凭空增加两张图里都不存在的元素

- If the two images **conflict** on design, color or proportion, `<image1>` **always wins**
- Angles covered by neither image are synthesised in the same design language
- No new elements that appear in neither image

✅ **适用 / Use when**：有背面图、多角度图、设定图 · You have a back view, multi-angle sheet or character sheet

---

> 💡 **一句话记法 / Rule of thumb**
> 只有正面 → 关；有背面或多角度 → 开，**并且记得开图2参考**。
> Front view only → OFF. Back view or multi-angle → ON, **and don't forget the image-2 toggle**.
